# Late Winner

> Late Winner is a free football career game you play in your browser, in English and French: take over a club, pick your line-up, make the calls during live matches, sign players and chase promotion. No download and no account needed, on a phone as on a computer.

The game has 198 clubs in five countries, each country with two divisions and a national cup; players are generated. A weekly challenge gives everyone the same club for ten league matchdays, with a ranking.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.latewinner.app/): start a career in one click, and what the game is
- [How to play](https://www.latewinner.app/how-to-play): a short guide, from your first match to the season's objectives
- [Weekly challenge](https://www.latewinner.app/challenge): this week's challenge and its rankings
- [What's new](https://www.latewinner.app/changelog): every update since the game opened
- [About](https://www.latewinner.app/about): who makes the game and how
- [Privacy](https://www.latewinner.app/privacy): what the game stores, why and for how long
